I haven't changed anything yet, for two reasons.

**1. The date doesn't match the weekday.** 20 October 2026 is a Tuesday, not a Sunday. The next Sunday is 18 October. Which is the maintenance day: Sunday 18 October or Tuesday 20 October?

**2. The Design Kit has no component for this banner.** The project rule is to copy all UI from the Design Kit (the `design-kit/` folder), value by value. If something is missing, I have to stop and ask you to add it to the kit rather than make it up. Right now the kit has:

- `tokens.css`: the shared design values. There are colours for background, surface, text and primary (green `#2f5d50`), plus one corner radius, two spacing sizes and one font.
- `components/button.html`: only the primary button.
- `components/card.html`: a white card.

To build the banner as asked, three things are missing:

| Missing from the kit | Why the banner needs it |
|---|---|
| A **Banner / Alert component** (layout, padding, where the icon and text go) | Nothing in the kit is meant for a full-width notice at the top of the page |
| A **warning colour** (background, text and border tokens, e.g. amber) | The only colours are neutral or green, so nothing reads as "warning" |
| A **dismiss control**: a close "×" button, its hover and focus states, and its accessible label | The only button is the large green primary one, which doesn't fit a close button |

**What I need from you:**
1. The correct date.
2. Either add a "Banner – warning, dismissible" component and its warning tokens to the Design Kit and re-vendor it here, or send me the values (colours, padding, close-button style) to add.

Once I have those, I'll build it on a new branch (not `main`). It will be a banner above the bookings card with a close button that hides it. I'll also ask whether you want it to stay hidden after a page reload, which would mean remembering the dismissal in the browser. The work will include a test, a `CHANGELOG.md` entry, and a commit with the Linear issue ID. Which Linear issue should I use?
